s: A company has 20 accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The accounts are in two OUs: development and production. Multiple teams use the development accounts. The company wants to control the cost that is associated with the development accounts. The company needs a solution that provides a notification when the forecasted monthly cost for all development accounts exceeds a threshold. A solutions architect creates an Amazon SNS topic and subscribes an email address to the topic. What should the solutions architect do next to meet the notification requirement with the LEAST configuration effort?
o: Enable Amazon CloudWatch billing alerts in the organization's management account. Create a CloudWatch billing alarm by configuring the EstimatedCharges metric for each development account as a linked account. Configure the SNS topic for email alerts when the EstimatedCharges metric value exceeds the threshold.

Create an AWS Cost and Usage Report in the organization's management account. Configure report delivery to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Glue job to extract the report data into Amazon Athena. Configure AWS Step Functions to analyze the consolidated cost of all the development accounts. Configure the SNS topic for email alerts when the cost exceeds the threshold.

Use AWS Budgets to create a cost budget in the organization's management account. Configure each development account as a linked account. Configure an alert threshold. Configure the SNS topic for email alerts.
Enable AWS Cost Explorer in the organization's management account. Configure each development account as a linked account. Configure an alert threshold. Configure the SNS topic for email alerts.

w.y: The requirement is an alert on forecasted monthly cost across a group of accounts. An AWS Budgets cost budget in the management account can be filtered to the development linked accounts and can alert on forecasted spend through SNS. It takes only a few settings.

o.A: CloudWatch billing alarms use EstimatedCharges, which is actual spend to date, not a forecast, and need one alarm per account.
o.B: CUR, Glue, Athena and Step Functions is a large custom pipeline for something Budgets does out of the box.
o.C: Correct: a cost budget filtered to the development linked accounts with a forecasted-cost alert sent to SNS.
o.D: Cost Explorer is for analysis and forecasting views; it doesn't send threshold alerts itself.

s: Creating an Amazon SNS topic for budget notifications
